scenario_summary: Customer is requesting a refund for a service subscription 34 days after cancellation, which is slightly outside the standard 30-day refund window.

conversation.message: Hi, my name is Sofía Martinez and I'm 38. I'm trying to get a refund for a service I canceled 34 days ago. I know your refund policy is usually 30 days, but I was traveling and only just saw the charge — I didn't realize it had gone through until now. Is there anything you can do?

Hello Sofía, I'm sorry to hear about the confusion regarding your billing while you were traveling. I would be happy to look into this for you. To get started, could you please provide your account number and the email address associated with your subscription?
Sure, my account number is 8849201 and the email is sofia.m@email.com.

Thank you, Sofía. I have successfully verified your account. I see the cancellation request was processed 34 days ago, and the charge occurred shortly thereafter. While our 'Standard Refund Policy (Section 4.2)' typically limits full refunds to a 30-day window, I can see you have been a loyal member with us for three years without any prior billing disputes.
That's correct, I've been with you for a long time. I really didn't intend to keep the service active, it was just a lapse in checking my accounts while abroad.

I completely understand. Because of your excellent account history, I am authorized to make a one-time exception to the 30-day policy. I have initiated a full refund for the charge of $49.99 to your original payment method.
Oh, that is such a relief! Thank you so much for your help with this.
You are very welcome, Sofía. The refund has been processed and you should see the credit appear in your bank account within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was everything. Thanks again!
It was my pleasure. Thank you for being a loyal customer, and have a wonderful day!

resolution_summary: Agent verified the account and applied a one-time policy exception for a loyal customer, successfully issuing a full refund for the charge.

judge_scores.justification: The agent handled the out-of-window refund request expertly by verifying account details, acknowledging the customer's travel circumstances with warmth, and citing Section 4.2 of the policy before applying a well-reasoned one-time exception. The issue was resolved efficiently within the agent's authority without any wasted turns or unnecessary escalations.
